{{Gemini}}
Gemini 6 is the 174th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 6th day of Gemini, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 25, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 7宮6日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 174|Chapter 174]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152194}}.
